title: Death penalty by lethal injection, shooting or electrocution? SC rejects plea
content: The Supreme Court declined to abolish hanging as an execution method.  New scientific evidence could prompt future reconsideration of this decision.  The court permitted the Centre to form an expert panel.  This panel will examine alternative execution methods for reduced pain.  Hanging remains the current method while reviews are pending.

title: 18 years of ruthless Virat Kohli: The man who refused to stay ordinary

Kohli retired from Tests and T20Is after winning IPL titles.

title: 'Take Gyanesh Kumar to US': Cong's jibe after Trump praises India's poll system

With a hint of sarcasm, Khera proposed sending India’s electronic voting machines and Kumar to the US. This debate highlights ongoing tensions between Congress and the Election Commission, particularly regarding accusations of vote theft during past Lok Sabha elections.

title: US green card approvals drop 35%, Indians hit hardest
content: Recent data indicates a considerable drop in US green card approvals for extraordinary workers, with Indian technology professionals facing the brunt of these new regulations. The USCIS has raised the bar for evidence needed in applications, prompting many Indian nationals to seek immigration options in other countries. Experts caution that these challenges will likely persist, complicating the path to US residency for skilled individuals.

title: TISS names new chief guest weeks after CJI visit sparked 'protest fears'

title: MacKenzie Scott helped abolish $40B in medical debt; how mechanics work
content: MacKenzie Scott's donations have enabled medical debt abolition across America. Her approach allows acquiring and erasing patient debt at steep discounts. This model has inspired other billionaires to contribute millions to similar initiatives. While philanthropic efforts provide immediate relief, policy reform remains stalled. Lasting change may require systemic reforms addressing the root causes of medical debt.

title: ‘No safe harbour if law violated’: Govt’s message to Meta on content moderation

The government seeks greater local sensitivity in content moderation decisions. Deepfakes and synthetically generated content require clear labeling for users. WhatsApp usernames are also being examined across all messaging platforms.

title: Indian-origin teen built anti-cyberbullying platform at 13, now runs nonprofit

This initiative grew into a global non-profit organization supporting millions of students worldwide.  Prabhu's work earned her significant recognition and substantial funding for her impactful efforts.  She continues to lead ReThink Citizens, promoting digital wellness and a kinder internet.  Her dedication exemplifies how one motivated individual can drive significant positive social change.

title: Liechtenstein ends 400-year rule excluding women from royal succession
content: Liechtenstein has made a progressive move by updating its royal succession laws to favor gender equality. Now, the first-born child will inherit the throne, breaking traditional norms. This decision aligns with several European countries where female heirs are already established, like Great Britain, which pioneered similar reforms in 2011. Meanwhile, Japan still grapples with its frustrating male-only inheritance policy that raises many questions.

title: Reliance Jio brings back Jio Prime with ‘one-year price guarantee’: Details

title: When calculus meets fractions! UC Berkeley professor raises math alarm

She links the widening preparation gap to changes in admissions testing and notes that calculus readiness has fallen significantly since standardized testing was suspended. content: president brushed aside reports of deteriorating conditions aboard the USS Abraham Lincoln . he later sharply rebuked a reporter during a tense Oval Office exchange . the remarks came during an oval office media interaction .

title: '39k soldiers guarding you from Kim': Trump cuts S Korea military drills over Iran
content: president Donald Trump has put fresh strain on Washington’s security ties with Seoul . he said south Korea refused to assist the US in its military operation against Iran . Trump also questioned the cost of America’s defence commitments to South Korea .

title: Delhi Police reject claims of 'excessive force' at Jantar Mantar student protest
content: police deny using 'excessive force' during march from Jantar Mantar to parliament . affidavit says police used only graded force, with around 5,000 personnel deployed to manage a crowd of more than 30,000 people spread across 3 km .

title: 'I apologise on his behalf': Vijay after minister's Karunanidhi reference
content: state forest minister apologises on minister's behalf for reference to late DMK leader . he refers to former CM and patriarch late M Karunanidhi by name . the reference triggered protests from opposition DMk members .

title: 2 killed in school shooting in Philippines’ Zamboanga
content: the suspect appeared to be wearing a body camera and livestreaming the attack at the high school on the ateneo de Zamboanga university campus . two other people were injured, as cited by news agency AP . the suspect initially opened fire at a teacher, although it was not immediately clear whether the teacher was hit .

title: BJP names in-charges for poll-bound UP, Punjab & Gujarat
content: the BJP appointed state in-charges for poll-bound Uttar Pradesh and Punjab . the saffron party will seek a third consecutive term . BJP national president Nitin Nabin appointed national general secretary and national secretary Vinod Tawde .
